components.name: Report link
components.css: .ds-link{font-family:var(--font-manrope, Manrope),sans-serif;color:var(--report-accent, #a6e2ce);font-size:14px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px;transition:color .16s ease,background-color .16s ease,border-color .16s ease;}.ds-link:hover{color:var(--fg, oklch(94% 0.009 265))}.ds-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--report-accent, #a6e2ce);outline-offset:5px;}

components.name: Task selector
components.description: An ordinary button with a persistent pressed-state rule.
components.css: .ds-task{font-family:var(--font-manrope, Manrope),sans-serif;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;text-align:left;padding:0 0 20px;min-height:96px;color:var(--report-muted, #adb5b5);cursor:pointer;transition:color .16s ease,background-color .16s ease,border-color .16s ease;}.ds-task[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--report-accent, #a6e2ce);border-bottom-color:var(--report-accent, #a6e2ce)}.ds-task:hover{color:var(--fg, oklch(94% 0.009 265))}.ds-task>span{display:block;font-size:18px;font-weight:650;margin-bottom:8px}.ds-task>small{display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--report-muted, #adb5b5);max-width:35ch}.ds-task:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--report-accent, #a6e2ce);outline-offset:5px;}

components.name: Case select
components.html: <label class="ds-case-label" for="ds-case">Explore a test case</label><select class="ds-select" id="ds-case"><option>Equal shares</option><option>No expenses</option></select>
components.css: .ds-case-label{font-family:var(--font-manrope, Manrope),sans-serif;display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--fg, oklch(94% 0.009 265));margin-bottom:10px}.ds-select{font-family:var(--font-manrope, Manrope),sans-serif;background:var(--bg-raised, oklch(18% 0.01 270));border:1px solid var(--report-rule, #343c3c);color:var(--fg, oklch(94% 0.009 265));min-height:44px;padding:8px 35px 8px 12px;font-size:14px;border-radius:3px;max-width:100%}.ds-select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--report-accent, #a6e2ce);outline-offset:5px;}

components.css: .ds-details{font-family:var(--font-manrope, Manrope),sans-serif;color:var(--fg, oklch(94% 0.009 265));border-bottom:1px solid var(--report-rule, #343c3c);padding:18px 0;font-size:14px}.ds-details summary{min-height:24px;line-height:1.65;cursor:pointer;transition:color .16s ease,background-color .16s ease,border-color .16s ease;}.ds-details[open] summary{margin-bottom:18px}.ds-details summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--report-accent, #a6e2ce);outline-offset:5px;}.ds-details p{color:var(--report-muted, #adb5b5);font-size:14px;line-height:1.8;margin:0;max-width:72ch}

narrative.overview:
A software test report viewed at a desk at night. Dark surfaces, readable Manrope, thin rules, and restrained mint links give exact inputs and results room to be understood. The active system is code-led and uses no shipping raster imagery or approved visual comp.

This document records the implemented v1.3 system. The shared header and footer use this system; historical benchmark content retains its legacy styles, including Barlow Condensed, sports graphics, and older score colors. Those archival treatments are not defaults for new active screens.
keyCharacteristics: Readable sentence-case headings and plain task names.
Flat rows and literal code, with clearly labeled expected results.
Visible control states and local scrolling for long code.

rules.name: The Labeled State Rule
rules.body: Status color always accompanies a meaningful text label; an unavailable attempt remains visibly unscored.

dos: Do use Manrope for active headings, prose, and controls; use IBM Plex Mono for code.
Do preserve visible focus, selected-state borders, and text labels alongside status colors.
Do distinguish published fixtures from saved model answers and keep unscored attempts explicit.
Do keep familiar task language, fast runs, and the lowest supported effort clear in the interface.
Do preserve historical routes and their original presentation without blending benchmark versions.
donts: Don't revive the basketball or Counterexample identity on active v1.3 surfaces.
Don't add promotional slogans, decorative imagery, simulated results, or fictional live statuses.
Don't turn provider failures into zero scores or style a single run as a reliable ranking.
Don't replace the report's flat rows with decorative elevated cards.
